messages:
maria: Heads-up: nightly eval GH Actions job is deadlocking when Buildkite PR runners also upload shards. Seeing 503s / retries. @ajay any idea?

ajay: Yup, noticed it ~2am. Symptoms: runner image rotates -> kube pod restart -> both jobs write same artifact path -> S3 put returns 409 / ETag mismatch. Logs show repeated retries.

sasha: Can you paste the workflow concurrency/setup? Might be concurrency groups colliding between nightly and PR.

maria: Paste of current snippet:
```yaml
concurrency:
  group: evals-nightly
  cancel-in-progress: false
```

ajay: We intentionally set cancel=false so nightly doesn't get canceled by newer nightly. PRs use `group: evals-pr-${{ github.head_ref }}` but runner label reuse can still cause simultaneous uploads to same `latest` prefix.

noah: Root cause looks like shared S3 prefix: `/evals/artifacts/latest`. Both nightly and PR writes use fixed names for shards. Need unique per-run prefix (run_id or commit sha) and atomic update of a pointer.

luis: For backwards compat we kept a stable `latest` pointer. Suggest upload to `/evals/artifacts/${{ github.run_id }}/...` then write a small `latest.json` with metadata to point consumers. That avoids concurrent blob overwrites.

eval-ci-bot: CI summary: gh-actions/nightly-evals -> 3 retries, 2 flakes, 1 host-unresponsive in last run.

maria: Proposed plan: (1) set `EVAL_ARTIFACT_PREFIX=${{ github.run_id }}` in GH workflow env, (2) reporter uploads to `${prefix}/shard-{n}.tgz`, (3) after successful upload, write `latest-pointer.json` with commit/run metadata and md5s. Also change uploader to use temp path then copy.

sasha: Also consider a lightweight preflight lock probe: check `/locks/${prefix}.lock` TTL before starting upload, with exponential backoff. Could be a small python script under `tools/ci/` so both GHA and BK can call it.

ajay: Prefer avoiding locks if possible. S3 is eventually consistent for overwrite semantics; best pattern: upload to a run-scoped prefix + a single atomic pointer object (small JSON) that contains the canonical locations. Consumers read pointer -> fetch artifacts. Avoids rename.

noah: For PR gating we must keep latency <15m. So: use per-run prefix, shorten artifact assemble step, and make pointer update the final step. That keeps PR gates fast and prevents interference with nightly.

luis: Also add an alert on buildkite: `artifact-upload-failures > 5/10m` pushing to #eng-ml and oncall.

maria: I'll open a small PR to change GH workflow env + uploader behavior. Will do dry-run on my fork first. CC @ajay @sasha for review. ETA: 24h for PR, 48h for staged rollout. :thumbsup:

ajay: Once PRs are ready I can add a short Buildkite change to use the same prefix logic so both runners are consistent.

sasha: And I'll update the eval dashboard so it reads `latest-nightly` vs `latest-pr` pointers rather than assuming a single `latest`. Avoids UX break.

maria: Thanks everyone — saving this thread into the PR description. If the dry-run passes I'll flip `cancel-in-progress` if needed, but prefix separation is the primary fix.

luis: FYI: I also bumped S3 client retry to 5 -> should help transient 503s but not ETag conflicts.

maria: Ok closing loop. Will post PR link here when ready.
